column3: Type what you want to send in Unicode and press backtick (`), it will be sent.
C1 for characters where case is not relevant. C for characters where case is relevant.
For characters that are used inside words, use the '?' syntax.
If we type (atom`), we get (om`). How to deal with this issue
Remove the '?' syntax out for things that should not be a part of a word.
Keep the '?' syntax for letters and diacritics and other things that are used without spaces.
Place the longer triggering word above the shorter one
Otherwise, upon trigger, youget "under⁀" instead of "‿"
